author: claude
desc: STRATEGIC REDIRECT for USB, prompted by the Linux 7.0 Apple Silicon DT work (Phoronix, 2026-07). Upstream is landing the COMPLETE USB3 description for M1/M2: per port, an Apple Type-C PHY (atcphy), a combo PHY for USB2/USB3/USB4-TB/DP, a Synopsys dwc3 controller, TWO DART iommu instances, and a CD321x USB PD controller. That last element owns CC detection, data/power role and VBUS sourcing — which is precisely our blocker: the 2026-07-21 right-port smoke reached xHCI root hubs but no child device, because the bus-powered stick has no VBUS. Our apple,force-host-mode patch exists specifically because 'the current T6040 bring-up DT has no supported SPMI-HPM/Type-C connector path', i.e. we bypassed the very mechanism that would give us VBUS. VERIFIED PRESENT IN OUR TREE: the PD driver binds apple,cd321x (drivers/usb/typec/tipd/core.c:2024, with cd321x_status/struct cd321x/cd321x_read_data_status); the atcphy driver exists (drivers/phy/apple/atc.c) and is TUNABLE-DRIVEN from the ADT exactly like PCIe (apple,tunable-axi2af, -common-a/-common-b, -lane0/1-usb, -lane0/1-cio); and t602x-dieX.dtsi / t600x-dieX.dtsi already instantiate the whole stack as a working template. VERIFIED ABSENT: atcphy has only a t8103 compatible, and our t6040-j614s DT contains no atcphy, typec, cd321x or usb-role-switch node at all. TASK: adapt the t602x-dieX.dtsi pattern to t6040 with ADT-derived addresses and the ADT's own apple,tunable-* values, add a t6040 atcphy compatible, and describe the PD controller. macvdmtool reports hpm0 at i2c0@9B040000/AppleS5L8940XI2CController/hpmBusManager@6B/AppleHPMBusController/hpm0/AppleHPMARMI2C, so the PD controller is on I2C — check whether the right port's HPM sits on the same bus. WHY THIS MATTERS: if it works, it REPLACES the HPM R3 approach entirely — reviewed upstream drivers doing CC/PD instead of hand-rolled 4CC writes whose sequence is not even decoded (096). UNKNOWNS, do not assume: the article covers M1/M2 only, never M4/t6040/t6041; our notes call the part SN201202x while m1n1-hpm2 carries tps6598x.c, which makes the CD321x/TPS6598x family likely but NOT established; and whether M4's atcphy register layout matches t8103/t600x/t602x is unknown. Relates to 023 (atcphy-track-upstream), supersedes the urgency of 096/097 if it lands. Evidence: done/2026-07-26-t6040-usb-vbus-blocker-and-roleswap-decode-gap.md.
progress: 2026-07-27 SCOPED, AND IT LOOKS LIKE DT-ONLY WORK. Two findings that shrink this a lot. (1) UPSTREAM STATUS (Asahi 6.19 progress report): the Synopsys dwc3 and TI USB-PD controller driver changes are ALREADY MERGED; only the atcphy driver awaits review. And M3 support is 'about where M1 was at the first beta' with keyboard, touchpad, WiFi, NVMe and USB3 ALL WORKING behind local m1n1/kernel patches not yet PR'd — relevant because our own m1n1 pcie.c already types t6040 as APCIE_T6031/APCIE_T8122, i.e. M3-generation, so M3 work is the right base to track. (2) THE ATCPHY DRIVER IS ALREADY SoC-GENERIC. Both templates bind via a FALLBACK compatible: t600x-dieX.dtsi uses 'apple,t6000-atcphy','apple,t8103-atcphy' and t602x-dieX.dtsi uses 'apple,t6020-atcphy','apple,t8103-atcphy'. The driver only matches apple,t8103-atcphy — the SECOND entry — so the register layout is shared across M1, M1 Pro/Max and M2 and each SoC merely adds a specific first compatible. CONSEQUENCE: t6040 probably needs NO driver change; a node with compatible='apple,t6040-atcphy','apple,t8103-atcphy' would bind the existing driver. The work becomes DT: five reg entries with reg-names 'core','lpdptx','axi2af','usb2phy','pipehandler', #phy-cells=1, #reset-cells=0, orientation-switch, mode-switch, power-domains=<ps_atcN_usb>; plus the display-crossbar mux, the dwc3 node (reg-names 'dwc3-core','dwc3-apple', dr_mode='otg', usb-role-switch, role-switch-default-mode='host', two iommus, resets=<atcphyN>, phys=<atcphyN PHY_TYPE_USB2>,<atcphyN PHY_TYPE_USB3>), two DARTs, and the PD controller. All addresses ADT-derived, all apple,tunable-* values from the ADT exactly as PCIe does it. STILL UNVERIFIED: that the t6040 atcphy register layout actually matches (the shared compatible across three generations is strong evidence but not proof), and that the right port's PD controller is on the same I2C bus as hpm0. NOTE the dwc3 template uses dr_mode='otg' + usb-role-switch + role-switch-default-mode='host', which is the SUPPORTED way to get host mode — a proper replacement for our apple,force-host-mode hack.
